none: PAS CAM-949EC6: Roman Coin : A Copper alloy Contempory Copy of a Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Copper alloy contempory copy of a Nummus of Constantius II, AD355-361 (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows Soldier stabbing fallen horseman. Obverse shows draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads is illegible. Condition is worn, die axis is probably 12 o'clock. Weight is 0.78g, diameter is 12.30mm
